results.question: In TS 24.301 clause 5.5.1.3.7, what applies to abnormal cases on the network side?

results.question: What must the UE check upon receipt of the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message regarding the replayed UE security capabilities?
results.reference: the received replayed UE security capabilities, the received replayed UE additional security capabilities, if included in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message, and the received nonceUE have not been altered compared to the latest values that the UE sent to the network
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.4.3.3, NAS security mode command accepted by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall check that the replayed UE security capabilities are the same as the security capabilities that the UE sent to the network in the message that initiated the security mode control procedure (e.g., ATTACH REQUEST, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST, or SERVICE REQUEST).
results.evidence: The UE shall check that the UE security capabilities, EPS NAS ciphering, EPS NAS integrity keys and eKSI sent by the MME in the message are the same as the ones sent by the UE in the message which initiated the procedure. If this is not the case, the network shall reply with a SECURITY MODE REJECT message.

results.question: What is the only EMM procedure the UE can initiate when in NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state without PSM active?

results.question: During which procedures does the condition for including the replayed NAS message container apply?

results.evidence: If the UE has no valid current EPS security context, the UE shall include a NAS message container IE in the initial NAS message that it sends to the network as specified in subclause 4.4.6, if the initial NAS message is one of ATTACH REQUEST, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST, or CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST.

results.question: Which entity includes the EPS bearer context status IE to indicate active EPS bearer contexts?

results.question: For what purpose can the UE use the PLMN identity of the visited cdma2000 HRPD network as the PLMN identity of the target cell?
results.reference: For the purpose of S101 mode to S1 mode handover
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.2.2.3.7, NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
results.model_answer: For selecting a matching cdma2000 HRPD pre-registration (parameters) or to determine if pre-registration is needed, i.e. as the PLMN identity of the target cell in the cdma2000 HRPD pre-registration procedure
results.evidence: If the UE receives an indication from the lower layers that a cdma2000 HRPD pre-registration is required, the UE may use the PLMN identity of the visited cdma2000 HRPD network as the PLMN identity of the target cell for the purpose of cdma2000 HRPD pre-registration.

results.question: In the case where the UE requested combined TA update for EPS and 'SMS only' and the TA UPDATE ACCEPT indicates success for EPS and non-EPS services, what can the UE do regarding CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION or Paging with CN domain indicator set to 'CS'?

results.evidence: If the tracking area updating procedure is not for emergency bearer services and the TA UPDATING ACCEPT message includes the EPS update result IE set to 'combined TA/LA updated' or 'combined TA/LA updated and ISR activated' with the additional update result IE indicating 'SMS only', the UE shall consider that it is IMSI attached for EPS services and non-EPS services and that it is capable of receiving CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION or Paging with CN domain indicator set to 'CS' via the E-UTRAN.

results.question: What is the purpose of the integrity protection algorithm for NAS signalling messages?

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 4.4.4, Integrity protection of NAS signalling messages
results.model_answer: To provide integrity protection and enable verification of the integrity of NAS signalling messages exchanged between the UE and the MME.
results.evidence: The NAS integrity algorithm shall be used to provide integrity protection of the NAS signalling messages.

results.question: When bits 7 and 8 are set to '11', which bits can be used for future extensions of the SERVICE REQUEST message?

results.model_answer: Bits 1 to 6

results.question: What shall the UE do according to cell selection procedures when a cell is found?
results.reference: perform cell selection according to 3GPP S 36.304 [21] and choose an appropriate substate
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.2.2.3.7, NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform the actions specified for that cell if it is suitable, i.e., camp on that cell.
results.evidence: Upon completion of the cell selection procedures, if a cell is found, the UE shall perform the actions specified for that cell in subclause 4.2 of 3GPP TS 36.304.

results.question: When shall the Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE be included in the message?
results.reference: only if the network wishes to transmit the APN-AMBR values to the UE for possible uplink policy enforcement and at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element in clause 9.9.4.2
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.6.17, Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate
results.model_answer: It shall be included by the network if it supports the Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE and if the value of extended APN-AMBR for the downlink or the uplink exceeds the maximum value that can be encoded in the APN-AMBR IE (i.e., 65 Mbps).
results.evidence: Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate: This IE shall be included by the network if it supports the Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE and if the value of the APN-AMBR for the downlink or the uplink is higher than the maximum value that can be encoded in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE.

results.question: With what shall the MME integrity protect and encipher all signalling messages after stopping timer T3460?
results.reference: the selected NAS integrity and ciphering algorithms
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.4.3.4, NAS security mode control completion by the network
results.model_answer: The new EPS security context
results.evidence: Upon receipt of the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message, the MME shall stop timer T3460. From then onwards the MME shall integrity protect and encipher all signalling messages with the new EPS security context.

results.question: What must be true about the APN-AMBR values relative to the APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE for the Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE to be included?
results.reference: at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element in clause 9.9.4.2
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.6.17, Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate
results.model_answer: The APN-AMBR for downlink and/or uplink values are greater than 65,600 kbps (i.e., the maximum value that can be encoded in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE), requiring the extended IE to encode the actual value.
results.evidence: The network shall include the value for the extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE, if the APN-AMBR for the downlink and/or the uplink requires bit rates higher than the maximum value that can be encoded in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE.

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the EPS bearer context status IE?
results.reference: if it wants to indicate the EPS bearer contexts that are active within the UE
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.33.4, EPS bearer context status
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the EPS bearer context status IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message if the UE's tracking area updating procedure is not due to inter-system change, and the UE has one or more EPS bearer contexts established.
results.evidence: If the UE receives a request to establish a bearer while a tracking area updating procedure is ongoing, or the UE has one or more EPS bearer contexts active, the UE shall include the EPS bearer context status IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, indicating which EPS bearer contexts are active.

results.question: What shall the UE do if it requested a combined TA update for EPS services and 'SMS only' and the TA UPDATE ACCEPT indicates success for EPS and non-EPS services?
results.reference: the UE shall behave as if the combined tracking area updating procedure was successful for EPS services and "SMS only"
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.5.3.3.6, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall consider itself to be attached for EPS services and IMSI attached for non-EPS services (SMS only).
results.evidence: If the tracking area updating procedure was initiated for combined EPS/IMSI attach for SMS only and the TA update result IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message indicates 'combined TA/LA updated with IMSI attach', the UE shall set the EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED and shall consider itself to be attached for EPS services and IMSI attached for non-EPS services (SMS only).

results.question: What is the UE's behavior when E-UTRAN coverage is lost?
results.reference: the UE shall not initiate any EMM procedure except for cell and PLMN reselection
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.1.3.2.4.7, EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
results.model_answer: If the UE detects that E-UTRAN coverage has been lost before the relevant timer expires, the UE shall stop the timer and act as if the timer had expired.
results.evidence: If the UE detects that lower layers cannot deliver the message due to loss of E-UTRAN coverage or the timer expires before the network response is received, the UE shall stop the timer and shall proceed as if the timer had expired.

results.question: Which entity sends the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message?
results.reference: the UE
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.1, Activate dedicated EPS bearer context accept
results.model_answer: The UE
results.evidence: Upon receipt of the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message, the UE shall... the UE shall send an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message to the network.

results.question: What must be included in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message by the MME to trigger the condition for the replayed NAS message container?
results.reference: the MME included HASHMME in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.21.3, Replayed NAS message container
results.model_answer: The replayed UE security capabilities (i.e., the MME must include the UE security capabilities IE that it received from the UE, replayed back to the UE) together with, when applicable, the non-current native EPS security context indication, in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.evidence: "If the SECURITY MODE COMMAND does not include the non-current native EPS security context indication, the UE shall include the NAS message container IE if... the UE security capabilities that the network included in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message are different from the UE security capabilities that the UE sent to the network..."

results.question: Under what conditions shall a network include the Packet flow identifier IE?
results.reference: If the UE supports A/Gb mode and BSS packet flow procedures, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.3.6, Packet flow identifier
results.model_answer: The network shall include the Packet flow identifier IE if it is available.
results.evidence: This IE shall be included by the network if it is available.

results.question: Under what EPS optimization can the network initiate downlink transport even without PDN connections?
results.reference: control plane CIoT EPS optimization
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.6.3.3, Network initiated transport of NAS messages
results.model_answer: S1-U data transfer of user data via the MME, under EPS user plane CIoT EPS Optimization, without any PDN connections being established
results.evidence: If the network supports EPS user plane CIoT EPS optimization, the network can initiate downlink transport of user data via the MME using the S1-U data transfer even without any PDN connections established.

results.question: When is the Packet flow identifier IE mandatory for a network to include?
results.reference: If the UE supports A/Gb mode and BSS packet flow procedures, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.3.6, Packet flow identifier
results.model_answer: When the network initiates a secondary PDP context activation procedure for a PDP context type of PDP context (i.e., in the ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message), the Packet flow identifier IE is mandatory only if the network wants to indicate a specific packet flow identifier associated with the traffic flow template; otherwise it is optional. In general, per TS 24.301, the Packet Flow Identifier IE is mandatory for the network to include in the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message when a PDN connection is established as an emergency bearer service or when required by the network to identify the packet flow for the EPS bearer context.
results.evidence: The Packet flow identifier IE is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets and a maximum length of 4 octets, and it is mandatory for the network to include in the message when the network wants to assign a packet flow identifier to the traffic flow template of the PDP context/EPS bearer context.

results.question: Under what condition can the UE deactivate PSM?
results.reference: when the UE needs to send mobile originated signalling or user data
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.1.3.2.4.7, EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
results.model_answer: The UE can deactivate PSM at any time by not including (or requesting) the T3324 value in an ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, i.e., when it no longer wants to use power saving mode.
results.evidence: The UE may deactivate the use of power saving mode at any time by not indicating that it wants to use power saving mode (i.e. by not including the T3324 value IE) in the ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

results.question: What is the identified abnormal case on the network side related to lower layers and handover?
results.reference: Lower layers indication of non-delivered NAS PDU due to handover
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.4.5.4, Abnormal cases on the network side
results.model_answer: Lower layers indicate that a NAS message could not be delivered to the UE due to a handover (i.e., non-delivery of the NAS message caused by handover), which the network treats as an abnormal case requiring retransmission/abort action.

If the network receives an indication of non-delivery of the NAS message due to handover, the network shall retransmit the message, if the message could not be delivered due to an intra MME/SGSN handover, once the handover has been completed."

results.question: When is the UE not allowed to include the Requested WUS assistance information IE?

results.question: What is the purpose of sending an EMM STATUS message?

results.evidence: The purpose of the EMM STATUS message is to report at any time certain error conditions detected upon receipt of EMM protocol data.

results.question: What specific ESM information can the network retrieve using the ESM information request procedure?

results.evidence: The purpose of the ESM information request procedure is for the network to retrieve ESM information, i.e. protocol configuration options or APN or both from the UE during the attach procedure or the UE requested PDN connectivity procedure, if requested by the network.

results.question: Which network entity initiates the EPS bearer context modification procedure?

results.question: What determines the coding of the additional information value?

results.question: What shall not happen as seen from the radio interface upon receipt of an EMM STATUS message?

results.question: According to which specification shall the UE perform cell selection/reselection in the NO-CELL-AVAILABLE case?

results.question: What is the purpose of the EPS bearer context modification procedure?
results.reference: to modify an EPS bearer context or packet flow description(s) of an existing EPS bearer context

results.question: What is the purpose of the Additional information information element?

results.evidence: "The purpose of the Additional information information element is to transfer additional information between the network and the UE which is not covered by other information elements."

results.question: Under what condition may the UE include the Requested WUS assistance information IE?
results.reference: if it supports WUS assistance and it is not attaching for emergency bearer services
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.29.33, Requested WUS assistance information

results.question: What is the purpose of the ESM information request procedure?

results.evidence: The purpose of the ESM information request procedure is for the network to retrieve ESM information, i.e. protocol configuration options or APN or both from the UE during the attach procedure, if requested by the UE and if the MME has indicated in the ATTACH ACCEPT message that ESM information transfer will follow.

results.question: When does the UE include the Paging restriction IE according to clause 8.2.29.36?

results.question: What technical specification governs the cell selection/reselection procedure referenced in clause 5.2.3.2.6?

results.question: What must a UE attached for access to RLOS do if it needs to initiate an emergency call?

results.question: What capability must the UE have to potentially include the Requested WUS assistance information IE?

results.evidence: "The UE shall include the Requested WUS assistance information IE if it supports the provision of WUS assistance information as specified in 3GPP TS 36.304 [23A]."

results.question: What mode must a UE be in for access to RLOS to be applicable?
results.reference: WB-S1 mode only

results.question: What does the network indicate by including the EPS bearer context status IE?
results.reference: the EPS bearer contexts that are active for the UE in the network
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.26.5, EPS bearer context status
results.model_answer: The EPS bearer context status IE indicates which EPS bearer contexts are active in the network, allowing the UE to deactivate any active EPS bearer contexts locally that are not indicated as active by the network.

results.question: What shall the UE do on the fifth expiry of timer T3482 for a non-emergency PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST?
results.reference: abort the procedure, release the PTI allocated for this invocation and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 6.5.1.5, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.model_answer: On the fifth expiry of timer T3482, the UE shall abort the procedure, release the procedure transaction identity, and enter state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE.
results.evidence: If timer T3482 expires, the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message shall be retransmitted and timer T3482 shall be restarted. This retransmission is repeated four times, i.e. on the fifth expiry of timer T3482, the UE shall abort the procedure, release the procedure transaction identity and enter state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE.

results.question: Which clauses must be applied in order of precedence?
results.reference: Clauses 7.1 to 7.8 shall be applied in order of precedence
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 7.1, General
results.model_answer: The 'abnormal case' handling clauses (e.g., clauses covering multiple abnormal conditions in EMM/ESM procedures such as 5.5.1.2.7, 5.5.1.3.7, 5.5.3.2.7 and 6.5.1.5 of TS 24.301) must be applied in the order in which they are listed, i.e., in order of precedence, when more than one condition applies to a received message.
results.evidence: "If several of the abnormal cases described above apply, the UE shall apply the clauses in the order of precedence in which they are listed above."

results.question: How shall an EMM message received with security header type encoded as 0000 be treated?

results.question: What type of access to RLOS requests are supported for a UE attached for access to RLOS?
results.reference: UE originated access to RLOS requests
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.3.18, Restricted local operator services
results.model_answer: Emergency call and multimedia priority service (MPS) types of access are not supported; only requests for access to RLOS (Restricted Local Operator Services) itself are supported for a UE attached for access to RLOS.
results.evidence: For a UE attached for access to RLOS, only request types "access to RLOS" are supported. The UE shall not request "emergency" or other request types.

results.question: What type of attach does a UE set in the ATTACH REQUEST message to request access to Restricted Local Operator Services?
results.reference: EPS RLOS attach
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.3.18, Restricted local operator services
results.model_answer: EPS attach for restricted local operator services (RLOS attach)
results.evidence: The UE shall set the EPS attach type IE to 'EPS RLOS attach' in the ATTACH REQUEST message when requesting access to restricted local operator services.

results.question: Who always initiates and controls the EPS AKA procedure?
results.reference: the network
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.4.2.1, General
results.model_answer: The network
results.evidence: The EPS authentication and key agreement (EPS AKA) procedure is always initiated and controlled by the network.

results.question: When timer T3447 is running, when can the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message be sent if still necessary?
results.reference: when timer T3447 expires
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 6.5.1.5, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.model_answer: Only after timer T3447 expires, unless the request is triggered by a PDN disconnection due to a request from the network or upper layer, or a handover to a target where the PDN connection is not supported.
results.evidence: Timer T3447 is stopped if a new PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message needs to be sent... While T3447 is running, a new PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message for the same APN shall not be sent, unless it is triggered by a PDN disconnection due to a request from the network or upper layers, or a handover to a target where the requirements to support the PDN connection are not met, in which case the UE may send the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message before T3447 expires.

results.question: What procedure shall the UE perform according to 3GPP TS 36.304 when in NO-IMSI state?
results.reference: cell selection
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.2.2.3.5, NO-IMSI
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform PLMN selection according to 3GPP TS 23.122
results.evidence: If the UE is in state NO-IMSI, PLMN selection shall be performed according to 3GPP TS 23.122 [14].

results.question: What procedure shall a UE that is IMSI attached for non-EPS services initiate upon reception of a paging indication?
results.reference: a service request procedure or combined tracking area updating procedure
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.6.2.3.1, General
results.model_answer: The UE shall initiate the service request procedure (as specified in subclause 5.6.2) in response to the paging indication.
results.evidence: "If the UE is IMSI attached for non-EPS services and receives a paging indication with the CN domain indicator set to 'CS', the UE shall initiate the service request procedure as specified in subclause 5.6.2 in order to establish the NAS signalling connection needed for CS fallback." (3GPP TS 24.301, subclause 5.6.2.2)

results.question: When shall a UE initiate tracking area updating after an inter-system change from S101 mode to S1 mode?
results.reference: when the UE performs an inter-system change from S101 mode to S1 mode and has no user data pending
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.5.3.2.2, Normal and periodic tracking area updating procedure initiation
results.model_answer: A UE shall initiate the tracking area updating procedure after an inter-system change from S101 mode to S1 mode if the tracking area identity of the current serving cell is not included in the UE's stored TAI list.
results.evidence: 5.5.3.2.4 Tracking area updating procedure initiation: 'The UE shall initiate the tracking area updating procedure ... f) if the UE enters S1 mode as a result of an inter-system change from S101 mode to S1 mode and the current TAI is not in the list of tracking area identities that the UE previously registered in the network.'

results.question: What procedures shall a UE execute when its configuration on use of SMS changes while operating in PS mode 1 or PS mode 2?
results.reference: Transit from PS mode 1 to CS/PS mode 1 or from PS mode 2 to CS/PS mode 2. Combined tracking area update with IMSI attach, (with or without "SMS only")
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 4.3.2.5, Change of configuration regarding the use of SMS
results.model_answer: The UE shall execute the Tracking Area Updating procedure
results.evidence: If the UE's usage setting or the UE's configuration on use of SMS over NAS is changed while the UE is operating in PS mode 1 or PS mode 2 of operation, the UE shall initiate a tracking area updating procedure indicating this change in the EPS update type IE and providing the MS network feature support IE with the corresponding change of the SMS services indicator.

results.question: When a UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 changes configuration to prefer SMS over IP networks, is able to use SMS via IMS, and has no CS voice capability, what two actions must it take?
results.reference: transit from CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1 or from CS/PS mode 2 to PS mode 2; and detach for non-EPS services
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 4.3.2.5, Change of configuration regarding the use of SMS
results.model_answer: The UE shall stop timer T3245 if it is running, and shall set the EMM cause value #15 'no suitable cells in tracking area' handling to be disabled for this PLMN if it was previously enabled.
results.evidence: If the UE changes its configuration to prefer SMS over IP networks to SMS over NAS, and the UE is capable of SMS over IMS and not capable of CS voice, the UE shall stop timer T3245, if running, and shall set the EMM cause value #15 handling to be disabled for this PLMN, if enabled.

results.question: What does security protection of EPS NAS messages involve?
results.reference: integrity protection and ciphering of the EMM and ESM NAS messages
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 4.4.1, General
results.model_answer: Integrity protection and ciphering of the NAS messages
results.evidence: Security protection of NAS messages consists of integrity protection and ciphering of the NAS messages, as specified in 3GPP TS 33.401.

results.question: What is one reason, besides protocol configuration options, for the UE to include the ESM information transfer flag IE?
results.reference: wishes to provide an access point name for the PDN connection to be established during the attach procedure
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.20.2, ESM information transfer flag
results.model_answer: The UE includes the ESM information transfer flag IE if it needs to send an APN (Access Point Name) that must be transferred via ESM information request/response signaling.
results.evidence: "The UE shall include this information element if it needs to send APN or protocol configuration options or both, and the UE needs to conceal the APN or protocol configuration options or both, or the UE needs to send information which does not fit in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message."

results.question: In which message during the attach procedure shall the UE include the ESM information transfer flag IE?
results.reference: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.20.2, ESM information transfer flag
results.model_answer: ATTACH REQUEST
results.evidence: If the UE needs to send PCO, or APN, or both, and the UE sets the ESM information transfer flag in the ATTACH REQUEST message, then after receiving ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message, the UE shall send ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message.

results.question: What procedures must a UE in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 execute if it changes to prefer SMS over IP networks, can use SMS via IMS, and has voice domain preference for E-UTRAN set to "IMS PS voice only"?
results.reference: transit from CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1 or from CS/PS mode 2 to PS mode 2; and detach for non-EPS services
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 4.3.2.5, Change of configuration regarding the use of SMS
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform a tracking area updating procedure with the EPS update type IE set to 'combined TA/LA updating with IMSI attach' indicating that it is capable of and configured to use SMS over IP networks.
results.evidence: If a UE that supports both CS fallback and SMS over IP: a) changes from preferring SMS over generic NAS transport or SGs to preferring SMS over IP; and b) is capable of and configured to use SMS over IP, and additionally if the UE's voice domain preference for E-UTRAN indicates 'IMS PS voice only' and CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 of operation applies, the UE shall perform a tracking area updating procedure indicating support for SMS over IP as specified in subclause 5.5.3.

results.question: How is operation of a network without ciphering achieved?
results.reference: by configuring the MME so that it always selects the "null ciphering algorithm", EEA0
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 4.4.1, General
results.model_answer: By use of EEA0 (the null ciphering algorithm) as the ciphering algorithm for the NAS and, if applicable, AS security context
results.evidence: Operation of a network without ciphering can be achieved by use of EEA0 as the ciphering algorithm.

results.question: Besides the SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE, which other message is not a plain NAS message and shall not be included?
results.reference: SERVICE REQUEST message
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 9.7, NAS message
results.model_answer: SERVICE REQUEST message
results.evidence: The SERVICE REQUEST message and the SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE are not plain NAS messages and shall not be included in the NAS message container IE.

results.question: What is the purpose of transmitting the APN-AMBR to the UE?
results.reference: for possible uplink policy enforcement
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.6.7, APN-AMBR
results.model_answer: The APN-AMBR is transmitted to the UE so that the UE can apply it to the uplink direction, enabling the UE to limit the aggregate bit rate of all non-GBR bearers associated with that APN, thereby controlling uplink traffic in accordance with the bit rate authorized by the network.
results.evidence: The UE shall use the APN-AMBR to limit the uplink bit rate as set forth above, i.e. the network provides the APN-AMBR value to the UE so that the UE can enforce it for the uplink traffic of all non-GBR bearers belonging to the same APN.

results.question: At which reference point are the EMM procedures for EPS services used?
results.reference: radio interface (reference point "LTE-Uu")
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.1.1, General
results.model_answer: At the LTE-Uu reference point
results.evidence: The EPS mobility management (EMM) procedures are used for the mobility management for EPS services at the LTE-Uu reference point (see 3GPP TS 36.401).

results.question: What is computed by the USIM during a successful EPS authentication procedure?
results.reference: the CK and IK
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.4.2.1, General
results.model_answer: The USIM computes RES (the authentication response), CK and IK (the ciphering and integrity keys), and derives KASME from CK, IK and the serving network identity.
results.evidence: Upon receipt of the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message, the UE shall check the validity of the AUTN provided as described in subclause 6.1.3.1 of TS 33.401 [19]. If accepted, the USIM computes a response RES and provides it, together with the calculated CK, IK to the ME. The ME shall then compute KASME from CK, IK and ASME identity as specified in TS 33.401 [19] and shall calculate KSI(ASME) as specified in subclause 3GPP TS 33.401 [19].

results.question: Under what condition is the APN-AMBR IE included in a message?
results.reference: when the network wishes to transmit the APN-AMBR to the UE for possible uplink policy enforcement
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.6.7, APN-AMBR
results.model_answer: The APN-AMBR IE is included if the network wants to indicate/change the APN-AMBR for the APN associated with the default EPS bearer being established or modified.
results.evidence: This IE is included if the network wants to indicate or change the APN-AMBR of the APN.

results.question: Under what condition can all EMM procedures described in this clause be performed?
results.reference: if a NAS signalling connection has been established between the UE and the network
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.1.1, General
results.model_answer: A NAS signalling connection exists between the UE and the network
results.evidence: The EMM procedures described in this clause can only be performed if a NAS signalling connection exists between the UE and the network.

results.question: What type of pending messages must a UE have to include the NAS message container IE?
results.reference: pending SMS messages to be sent
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.33.3, NAS message container
results.model_answer: An initial NAS message (e.g., ATTACH REQUEST, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST, or SERVICE REQUEST) pending to be sent, for which the NAS signalling connection is being established
results.evidence: If the UE has a NAS message for which security protection is not applied (e.g. ATTACH REQUEST, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST or SERVICE REQUEST) pending to be sent, and the UE needs to send this message integrity protected, ciphered and integrity protected once the NAS security context to be used has been taken into use, the UE shall include the NAS message container IE in the RRC message used to transfer the initial NAS message.

results.question: To which entity does the EMM entity forward the NAS message container contents?
results.reference: the SMS entity
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.6.3.3, Network initiated transport of NAS messages
results.model_answer: The ESM entity (i.e., the EMM sublayer forwards the contents of the NAS message container IE to the ESM sublayer for further processing)
results.evidence: "Upon receipt of the... message containing a NAS message container IE, the EMM entity in the UE/MME shall forward the message contained in the NAS message container IE to the ESM entity."

results.question: What is the title of the clause that describes when no procedure transaction exists?
results.reference: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 6.1.3.2.3, PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.model_answer: No procedure transaction identity available or active
results.evidence: 6.7.3.4 No procedure transaction identity available or active

results.question: What type of inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode is specified for the inclusion of the GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE?
results.reference: to S1 mode
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.29.3, GPRS ciphering key sequence number
results.model_answer: Inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode
results.evidence: GPRS ciphering key sequence number - This IE is included if the UE has valid GPRS security parameters, and the tracking area updating procedure is due to an inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode.

results.question: Under what condition regarding emergency services must the network include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE?
results.reference: the UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.26.27, Negotiated WUS assistance information
results.model_answer: The network shall not include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE if the UE is establishing a PDN connection for emergency bearer services or is registered for emergency services (i.e., WUS assistance information is not provided when emergency services are involved).
results.evidence: If the UE is establishing a PDN connection for emergency bearer services or is registered for emergency services, the network shall not include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE in the ATTACH ACCEPT message or in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.

results.question: What is described in clause 4.4.1 regarding EPS security contexts?
results.reference: the principles for the handling of EPS security contexts in the UE and in the MME and the procedures used for the security protection of EPS NAS messages between UE and MME
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 4.4.1, General
results.model_answer: Clause 4.4.1 describes the concept and use of EPS security context, including how it is established, taken into use, and stored, distinguishing between mapped and native EPS security contexts, and their relation to EPS NAS security context parameters such as KASME, key set identifier (eKSI), and the current NAS security algorithms.
results.evidence: An EPS security context is established either by executing an EPS authentication and key agreement (AKA) procedure or by conversion of a UMTS or GSM security context into an EPS security context. The EPS security context becomes the current EPS security context when the UE and MME successfully complete a security mode control procedure, or when the UE and MME successfully complete a security context handling procedure during the tracking area updating or handover procedure.

results.question: To which entities does the mobility management sublayer provide connection management services?
results.reference: the session management (SM) sublayer and the short message services (SMS) entity of the connection management (CM) sublayer
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.1.1, General
results.model_answer: The EMM sublayer provides connection management services to the EPS Session Management (ESM) entity and other upper layer entities requiring such services, e.g. the Short Message Service (SMS) entity.
results.evidence: "The EPS mobility management sublayer also provides connection management services to the entities of the upper layers, e.g. the session management sublayer and the short message service (SMS) entity."

results.question: When must the network include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE according to clause 8.2.26.27?
results.reference: the UE supports WUS assistance, the MME supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance; and the UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.26.27, Negotiated WUS assistance information
results.model_answer: When the UE supports WUS assistance and the network wants to indicate the negotiated WUS assistance information to be used, i.e., only if the UE included the Requested WUS assistance information IE in the ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message and the network supports and decides to use WUS assistance.
results.evidence: This IE shall be included if the UE included the Requested WUS assistance information IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, and the network supports and decides to use WUS assistance information.

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE during an inter-system change?
results.reference: if the UE performs an A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in EMM-IDLE mode and the TIN indicates "P-TMSI"
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.29.3, GPRS ciphering key sequence number
results.model_answer: When the UE has valid GPRS ciphering key sequence number (i.e., a valid P-TMSI/GPRS security context) available from a previously performed GPRS attach procedure or inter-system change from S1 mode to A/Gb mode, and this is not superseded by a subsequent EPS security context, the UE shall include the GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message during an inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode.
results.evidence: If the UE has a valid GPRS ciphering key sequence number, the UE shall include the GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message when performing an inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode.

results.question: When shall the UE include the NAS message container IE?
results.reference: if it is in EMM-IDLE mode and has pending SMS messages to be sent
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.33.3, NAS message container
results.model_answer: When the UE sends an initial NAS message (ATTACH REQUEST, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST, or SERVICE REQUEST) that is not integrity protected, or that needs to be sent before security is activated, and the UE needs to protect NAS signalling information (such as the complete initial NAS message) that would otherwise be sent unprotected, it shall include the NAS message container IE containing this complete initial NAS message.
results.evidence: The UE shall include the NAS message container IE in the initial NAS message, if the UE needs to send a non-integrity protected initial NAS message (i.e. ATTACH REQUEST, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST or SERVICE REQUEST) that also needs to be protected once the security context is established, and the UE has a valid current EPS security context.

results.question: What is the main function of the ESM sublayer?
results.reference: to support the EPS bearer context handling in the UE and in the MME
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 6.1.1, General
results.model_answer: To support user data connectivity by establishing, maintaining, and releasing EPS bearer contexts (default and dedicated) between the UE and the network.
results.evidence: The EPS Session Management (ESM) sublayer performs the functions needed to support user plane data transfer, comprising EPS bearer context activation, modification and deactivation.

results.question: What shall the UE perform at the expiry of timer T3444 or T3445 if configured for eCall only mode?
results.reference: shall perform the eCall inactivity procedure at expiry of timer T3444 or T3445 (see clause 5.5.4)
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.2.3.2.1, NORMAL-SERVICE
results.model_answer: The UE shall locally release the established NAS signalling connection, if any.
results.evidence: If timer T3444 or T3445 expires, the UE, if configured for eCall only mode, shall locally release the NAS signalling connection, if any.

results.question: When is a default EPS bearer context activated?
results.reference: when the UE requests a connection to a PDN
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 6.1.1, General
results.model_answer: A default EPS bearer context is activated when the UE attaches to the network (i.e., during the ATTACH procedure), or when the UE requests a PDN connection using the UE requested PDN connectivity procedure.
results.evidence: The network shall activate a default EPS bearer context for a PDN connection during the attach procedure or during the UE requested PDN connectivity procedure.

results.question: What is the full name of the substate described as being chosen while the UE searches for PLMNs?
results.reference: EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.1.3.2.4.5, EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
results.model_answer: EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
results.evidence: EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH: The UE searches for a suitable PLMN.

results.question: Which 3GPP specification is referenced for network-based IP flow mobility?
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.2.3, NBIFOM container
results.model_answer: 3GPP TS 23.261
results.evidence: Network-based IP flow mobility is specified in 3GPP TS 23.261.

results.question: According to the clause, what condition exists regarding the procedure transaction?
results.reference: No procedure transaction exists
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 6.1.3.2.3, PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.model_answer: A procedure transaction identity (PTI) collision exists, i.e., the same PTI value is already assigned to another ESM signalling procedure that is still ongoing.
results.evidence: If a NAS message is received with a PTI value that is not the value allocated to the ongoing procedure or is already used for an existing procedure, the UE/network shall consider this as an abnormal case and shall not process the message as belonging to the procedure identified by that PTI.

results.question: What shall the UE initiate on the expiry of timer T3411?
results.reference: shall initiate a tracking area updating on the expiry of timer T3411
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.2.3.2.1, NORMAL-SERVICE
results.model_answer: On expiry of T3411 the UE shall re-initiate the attach procedure or the tracking area updating procedure (whichever was running when the timer was started).
results.evidence: T3411: 'On the expiry of this timer, the UE shall initiate the attach or tracking area updating procedure.' (3GPP TS 24.301, Table 10.2.2 / clauses 5.5.1 and 5.5.3)

results.question: What two network conditions must be satisfied for including the T3324 value IE?
results.reference: the network supports PSM and accepts the use of PSM
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.26.16, T3324 value
results.model_answer: The T3324 value IE is included only if (1) the UE requested PSM by including the T3324 value IE in the ATTACH REQUEST/TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, and (2) the network supports and accepts the use of power saving mode (PSM) for the UE.
results.evidence: "The T3324 value IE and the extended DRX parameters IE are included if the UE requested power saving mode (PSM) and if the network supports and accepts the use of PSM for the UE."

results.question: In which clause is the condition for including the ESM cause IE specified?
results.reference: when the UE requests the release of a dedicated bearer resource
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.10.3, ESM cause
results.model_answer: Annex C
results.evidence: The ESM cause IE shall be included if the network wants to indicate a specific reason for the requested procedure not being accepted; see clause C for the applicable ESM cause values.

results.question: What is the full name of the technology associated with the NBIFOM container?
results.reference: network-based IP flow mobility
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.3.2.3, NBIFOM container
results.model_answer: Network-Based IP Flow Mobility
results.evidence: NBIFOM container - This information element is coded as depicted in figure 9.9.4.11a.1, and table 9.9.4.11a.1, and encodes the parameters used for the network-based IP flow mobility (NBIFOM) feature.

results.question: What are the two alternative UE capability conditions that mandate the inclusion of the Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting IE in WB-S1 mode?
results.reference: the UE supports CS fallback and SMS over SGs; or if the UE is configured to support IMS voice, but does not support 1xCS fallback
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.29.19, Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting
results.model_answer: UE supports S1 mode with CIoT EPS optimization for control plane and user plane, or UE supports S1 mode without CIoT EPS optimization
results.evidence: Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting: This IE shall be included, if the UE supports WB-S1 mode and (UE support of S1 mode with CIoT EPS optimizations for control plane data and user plane data or UE support of S1 mode without CIoT EPS optimizations).

results.question: Which specific NAS message type is explicitly stated as not being a plain NAS message and therefore not included?
results.reference: SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE

results.model_answer: SERVICE REQUEST message
results.evidence: NOTE: The SERVICE REQUEST message is not a plain NAS message and, therefore, is not included in the list above.

results.question: In which UE state is the substate EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH chosen?

results.model_answer: EMM-REGISTERED
results.evidence: EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH: This substate is entered when the UE is searching for a suitable PLMN or SNPN.

results.reference: #15 "No suitable cells in tracking area"

results.model_answer: EMM cause #15 (No suitable cells in tracking area)
results.evidence: #15 (No suitable cells in tracking area)

results.question: Under what condition does a UE move to EMM-DEREGISTERED and GMM-DEREGISTERED during an intersystem change from A/Gb or Iu mode to S1 mode with no active PDP context?
results.reference: if EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported by the UE or the MME
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.1.4, Coordination between EMM and GMM
results.model_answer: If no PDN connection can be established (i.e., no PDP context can be mapped to a default EPS bearer context), the UE deletes the mapped EPS bearer context and enters state EMM-DEREGISTERED and GMM-DEREGISTERED.
results.evidence: If no PDN connection can be established, the UE shall delete the mapped EPS bearer context and shall proceed with clause 5.5.1.2 or 5.5.1.3 as appropriate, and stay in state EMM-DEREGISTERED and GMM-DEREGISTERED.

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the replayed NAS message container?
results.reference: if during an ongoing attach or tracking area updating procedure, the MME included HASHMME in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message and HASHMME has a different value from the hash value locally calculated at the UE as described in 3GPP S 33.401 [19]
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 8.2.21.3, Replayed NAS message container
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the NAS message container IE with the replayed (original) initial NAS message in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message only if the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message that triggered the security mode control procedure itself included the NAS message container IE, i.e., the network explicitly requested replay of the initial NAS message that was sent without integrity protection before the EPS security context was established.
results.evidence: If the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message included the NAS message container IE, the UE shall include the NAS message container IE in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message, and set it to the value of the NAS message that the UE had sent to the network within the initial NAS message that triggered the security mode control procedure.

results.question: What EMM cause value is set in the ATTACH REJECT message when it is combined with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message?
results.reference: #19 "ESM failure"
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.5.1.2.5, Attach not accepted by the network
results.model_answer: EMM cause #22 "congestion"
results.evidence: If the network receives an ATTACH REQUEST message combined with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message and the network needs to reject the PDN connectivity request, the network shall send an ATTACH REJECT message combined with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message... the EMM cause value shall be set to #22 'congestion'.

results.question: Which messages are accepted by the UE without integrity protection in certain situations?

results.question: What shall a UE configured for eCall only mode do at the expiry of timer T3444 or T3445?
results.reference: shall perform the eCall inactivity procedure at expiry of timer T3444 or T3445 (see clause 5.5.4)
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.2.3.2.3, LIMITED-SERVICE
results.model_answer: The UE shall retransmit the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message and shall reset and start timer T3444 or T3445, respectively. This retransmission is repeated four times, i.e., on the fifth expiry of timer T3444 or T3445, the UE shall continue with retransmission of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message four more times, i.e., up to five more times, and so on until the maximum number of allowed attempts is reached; if the UE is configured for eCall only mode, it shall keep on repeating the retransmission without limitation until the tracking area updating procedure is completed successfully or the eCall session is terminated.
results.evidence: For a UE configured for eCall only, retransmission of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message continues until the tracking area updating procedure is completed or the UE is switched off, i.e. the limit of five retransmissions does not apply.

results.question: In WB-S1 mode, what does the UE do if access is barred for 'originating signalling'?
results.reference: The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies the normal cell reselection process.

results.model_answer: If access is barred for 'originating signalling' in WB-S1 mode, the UE shall not start any NAS signalling procedure (e.g. ATTACH, TRACKING AREA UPDATING, SERVICE REQUEST) unless it is for an exception reporting, emergency bearer services, or a case explicitly excepted from access barring (e.g. responding to paging or for high priority access).
results.evidence: If access is barred for 'originating signalling' in WB-S1 mode, the UE shall not start the following: ATTACH REQUEST message unless it is for emergency bearer services; EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST or SERVICE REQUEST message unless it is a response to paging, for emergency bearer services, or for exception reporting; TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message unless it is for entering EMM-CONNECTED mode with the network or is triggered by an event that is exempt from access barring.

results.question: Under what condition can a UE send an UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message when timer T3346 is running, if the UE is configured for dual priority?

results.evidence: "If timer T3346 is running, the UE shall not send an UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message unless the UE is configured for dual priority and the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message needs to be sent for a request from the upper layers related to an emergency call."

results.question: What information is included with the emergency numbers in the Extended emergency number list IE?

results.question: When timer T3346 is running, when can the UE send the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message if it is still necessary?
