results.model_answer: The UE considers itself to be operating in limited service state.
results.evidence: If the 5GS registration result indicates "5GS services not allowed", the UE considers itself to be operating in limited service state as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122.

results.question: Where are the operator-defined access category definitions that can be deleted by the IE located?
results.reference: at the UE side
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.5.3, Operator-defined access categories
results.model_answer: On the USIM
results.evidence: The UE shall store the operator-defined access category definitions received in the operator-defined access category definitions IE in the USIM, if the USIM has an EFOACD file, and shall delete any of these definitions that are indicated for deletion from the USIM.

results.question: To what type of access attempt is a service request procedure initiated in 5GMM-IDLE mode mapped while an MMTEL voice call is ongoing?
results.reference: "MO MMTel voice call" type access attempt
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.6.1.7, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.model_answer: It is mapped to an access attempt for a mobile originated (MO) MMTEL voice call, i.e., Access Category 4 (MMTEL voice).
results.evidence: If the service request procedure is initiated while an MMTEL voice call is ongoing, the UE in 5GMM-IDLE mode initiating the service request procedure to establish a NAS signalling connection shall map the access attempt onto access identity 4 (MMTEL voice).

results.question: What can result from the UE informing upper layers of the failure of a service request for initiating an emergency PDU session?
results.reference: This can result in the upper layers requesting another emergency call attempt using domain selection as specified in 3GPPTS23.167[6]
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.6.1.6, Service request procedure for initiating an emergency PDU session not accepted by the network
results.model_answer: It can result in the upper layers requesting the establishment of an emergency call using CS fallback (i.e., the UE may fall back to circuit-switched domain for the emergency call).
results.evidence: If the service request was requested by the upper layers to establish an emergency PDU session, the UE shall inform the upper layers of the failure of the service request, which may result in the request for establishing an emergency call by CS fallback.

results.question: What is the form of the SUPI of the UE when EAP-TTLS with two phases of authentication is used for primary authentication and key agreement in an SNPN?
results.reference: in the form of a SUPI with the SUPI format "network specific identifier" containing a network-specific identifier
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.4.1.2.3A, Procedures related to EAP methods other than EAP-AKA' and EAP-TLS
results.model_answer: An NAI (Network Access Identifier) whose username part is the anonymous username
results.evidence: When EAP-TTLS with two phases of authentication is used for primary authentication and key agreement in an SNPN, the SUPI of the UE takes the form of a Network Access Identifier (NAI) as specified in 3GPP TS 23.003, with the username part of the NAI containing an anonymous username so that the real identity of the UE is not exposed in phase 1 of the EAP-TTLS procedure.

results.question: What shall the UE do after selecting the establishment cause for non-3GPP access?
results.reference: provide the selected establishment cause for non-3GPP access to the lower layers
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.7.2.1, General
results.model_answer: The UE shall provide the selected establishment cause to the lower layers for inclusion in the AN-parameters sent to the non-3GPP access network (e.g., to the N3IWF/TNGF).
results.evidence: After selecting the establishment cause for non-3GPP access, the UE shall provide the establishment cause to the lower layers for inclusion in the AN-parameters.

results.question: When a collision occurs between UE-requested PDU session establishment and network-requested PDU session modification for an MA PDU session, what shall the UE do?
results.reference: proceed with both the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure and the network-requested PDU session modification procedure
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.4.1.6, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall abort the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure and proceed with the network-requested PDU session modification procedure.
results.evidence: If a collision occurs between a UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure and a network-requested PDU session modification procedure for the same MA PDU session, the UE shall abort the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure and proceed with the network-requested PDU session modification procedure.

results.question: For which PDU session types is it not possible to derive a UL packet filter from a DL user data packet?
results.reference: PDU session type other than Ethernet, IPv4, IPv6 and IPv4v6
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.2.5.1.4.2, Derivation of packet filter for UL direction from DL user data packet
results.model_answer: Unstructured and Ethernet PDU session types
results.evidence: If the PDU session type is Ethernet or the PDU session type is Unstructured, the UE cannot derive an uplink packet filter from a downlink user data packet.

results.question: What is the UE required to do when receiving a non-integrity protected 5GMM SERVICE REJECT message with 5GMM cause #3?
results.reference: shall delete the list of equivalent PLMNs
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.6.1.5, Service request procedure not accepted by the network
results.model_answer: The UE shall not discard the message; instead it treats the SERVICE REJECT as if it had been received with integrity protection and proceeds with the actions defined for cause #3 (illegal UE) – i.e. it sets the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes the stored 5G-GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI and ngKSI, and considers the USIM invalid for 5GS services until switch-off/UICC removal.
results.evidence: If the SERVICE REJECT message is received without integrity protection, the UE shall discard the message unless the 5GMM cause value is #3 (illegal UE), #6 (illegal ME) or #7 (5GS services not allowed); if the 5GMM cause value is #3, #6 or #7, the UE shall proceed as if the SERVICE REJECT message was received integrity protected.

results.question: What must the UE support to include the Additional information requested IE?
results.reference: ciphered broadcast assistance data
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.22.1, General
results.model_answer: Support for disaster roaming.
results.evidence: The Additional information requested IE shall be included by the UE only if the UE supports disaster roaming and the UE wants to request the network to provide the list of PLMN(s) to be used in disaster condition.

results.question: What may the UE support acting as when EAP-TTLS with two phases of authentication is used?
results.reference: acting as EAP peer of EAP-TTLS with two phases of authentication as specified in 3GPPTS33.501[24] and acting as peer of a legacy authentication protocol as specified in 3GPPTS33.501[24]
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.4.1.2.3A, Procedures related to EAP methods other than EAP-AKA' and EAP-TLS
results.model_answer: An EAP-TTLS server
results.evidence: When EAP-TTLS with two phases of authentication (see IETF RFC 5281) is used, the UE may support acting as an EAP-TTLS server.

results.question: If the UE sent the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for a handover of an existing emergency PDU session between accesses and timer T3580 expires, what shall the UE consider?
results.reference: consider that the emergency PDU session is associated with the source access type
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.4.1.6, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall consider that the transfer of the existing emergency PDU session to the target access has failed.
results.evidence: If the T3580 timer expires, and the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message was sent for a handover of an existing emergency PDU session from a non-3GPP access to a 3GPP access, or vice versa, the UE shall consider that the transfer of the existing emergency PDU session to the new access has failed.

results.question: Who initiates and controls the EAP based authentication and key agreement procedure if the network decides to process the relay key request message?
results.reference: The EAP based authentication and key agreement procedure is initiated and controlled by the network.
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.5.4.1, General
results.model_answer: The network
results.evidence: The EAP based authentication and key agreement procedure is initiated and controlled by the network. However, the ME can reject the EAP-success message (see IETF RFC 3748 [49]) if the ME detects that the network has included the EAP-success message unprotected.

results.question: What establishment cause for non-3GPP access is used if the access attempt matches more than one rule?
results.reference: the establishment cause for non-3GPP access of the lowest rule number shall be used
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.7.2.2, Establishment cause for non-3GPP access
results.model_answer: mo-Data
results.evidence: If the access attempt matches more than one of the establishment cause values listed in table D.2, the UE shall select the establishment cause 'mo-Data'.

results.question: How are EAP messages exchanged between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the network during the procedure?
results.reference: The exchanges of EAP messages between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the network are relayed by the UE
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.5.4.1, General
results.model_answer: EAP messages are transported transparently between the remote UE and the network inside NAS messages, relayed over PC5 by the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE, without the relay UE interpreting their content.
results.evidence: The 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE relays the EAP message container between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the network transparently.

results.question: What is the purpose of the authentication and key agreement procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay?
results.reference: to perform the authentication for 5G ProSe remote UE initiated by the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay and to agree on the KAUSF_P and KNR_ProSe when the security for 5G ProSe communication via 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay is performed over control plane as specified in 3GPPTS33.503[56]
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.5.4.1, General
results.model_answer: To provide mutual authentication between the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE and the 5G ProSe remote UE, and to generate a security key (PRUK or PRUK ID related key) used to derive a security context for protecting subsequent PC5 communication (e.g., direct communication request) between the remote UE and the relay UE.
results.evidence: The purpose of the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay authentication and key agreement procedure is to provide mutual authentication between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE, and to generate the PRUK or a new key used to derive a security context between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE.

results.question: What shall the UE do on the first expiry of timer T3580 if the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message was sent with request type set to 'initial emergency request'?
results.reference: inform the upper layers of the failure of the procedure
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.4.1.6, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall resend the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message without changing the PTI or PDU session ID, and shall restart timer T3580.
results.evidence: Upon expiry of timer T3580, the UE shall resend the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message and shall reset and restart timer T3580. This retransmission is repeated four times, i.e. on the fifth expiry of timer T3580, the UE shall release the allocated PTI and PDU session ID... If the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message was sent with the request type set to 'initial emergency request', the UE shall resend the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message with the same content as in the previous transmission on each expiry of the timer T3580, until the fifth expiry.

results.question: What is the main function of the 5GS mobility management sublayer?
results.reference: to support the identification, security, mobility of a UE as well as generic message transport
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.1.1, General
results.model_answer: To establish and maintain access to 5G system services for the user, and to provide mobility and security support for the user's NAS signaling connection
results.evidence: The 5GS mobility management (5GMM) sublayer is used to support the mobility of the user equipment, such as informing the network of its present location and providing user identity confidentiality, and to provide connection management services to the connection management (5GMM-CONNECTED and 5GMM-IDLE modes), and to establish and maintain access to 5G system services for the user.

results.question: When deriving a UL packet filter from a DL Ethernet frame, under what Ethertype condition is an Ethertype component added?
results.reference: If the Ethertype field of the received DL user data packet is set to a value of 1536 or above
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.2.5.1.4.2, Derivation of packet filter for UL direction from DL user data packet
results.model_answer: An Ethertype component is added only if the Ethertype value of the DL Ethernet frame is not set to a value indicating that the frame is an IEEE 802.1Q or IEEE 802.1ad tagged frame (i.e., not a VLAN tag Ethertype).
results.evidence: If the Ethertype of the DL packet filter is not set to a value indicating that the frame is an IEEE 802.1Q C-TAG or S-TAG VLAN tagged frame, the UE shall include an Ethertype packet filter component set to the same value as in the DL packet filter.

results.question: How many times does the AMF retransmit the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message before aborting the procedure?
results.reference: four times
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.6.2.4, Network slice-specific authentication and authorization
results.model_answer: 4 times (i.e., 5 attempts total)
results.evidence: Upon expiry of timer T3585, the AMF shall retransmit the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and shall reset and restart timer T3585. This retransmission is repeated four times, i.e. on the fifth expiry of timer T3585, the AMF shall abort the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure.

results.question: What may the AAA server of CH support acting as?
results.reference: acting a server of a legacy authentication protocol as specified in 3GPPTS33.501[24]
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.4.1.2.2.1, General
results.model_answer: The AAA server of the Credentials Holder (CH) may support acting as an EAP server for primary authentication.
results.evidence: The AAA server of the Credentials Holder (CH) may support acting as an EAP server that terminates the EAP method used for primary authentication and key agreement, and communicates with the AMF and SEAF via the AUSF using AAA protocol.

results.question: For a DL IPv4 packet indicating ESP protocol, what condition must be met for UL packet filter derivation?
results.reference: an uplink IPSec SA corresponding to a downlink IPSec SA indicated in the security parameters index field of the received DL user data packet exists
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.2.5.1.4.2, Derivation of packet filter for UL direction from DL user data packet
results.model_answer: The Security Parameter Index (SPI) in the DL packet's ESP header must be used as the SPI in the derived UL packet filter
results.evidence: if the protocol identifier/next header field indicates ESP, the security parameter index of the received downlink packet shall be used as the security parameter index in the derived uplink packet filter

results.question: What specific GNSS state is referenced in the note about satellite NG-RAN access?
results.reference: GNSS cold state
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.1.1, General
results.model_answer: The 'acquiring GNSS position' state (i.e., the UE attempting to acquire a valid GNSS position/fix before accessing satellite NG-RAN)
results.evidence: NOTE: The UE needs a valid GNSS position for satellite NG-RAN access. If the UE is in the state of acquiring GNSS position, the UE is not considered to be unable to access satellite NG-RAN due to lack of a valid GNSS position.

results.question: What shall the UE do if a service request for initiating an emergency PDU session cannot be accepted by the network and the UE is in the same selected PLMN where the last service request was attempted?
results.reference: inform the upper layers of the failure of the procedure; or de-register locally, if not de-registered already, attempt initial registration for emergency services
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.6.1.6, Service request procedure for initiating an emergency PDU session not accepted by the network
results.model_answer: The UE shall not re-attempt to establish the PDU session for emergency services in that PLMN and shall attempt to select another PLMN, as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122, subclause 4.9.
results.evidence: If the service request was initiated to request establishment of a PDU session for emergency services and the network rejects the service request procedure, and the UE is in the same PLMN where the last service request for emergency services was attempted, the UE shall not attempt to establish PDU session for emergency services in the same PLMN and shall attempt to select another PLMN as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122 [5], subclause 4.9.

results.question: What does the network do if a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message is received with a different access type than the ongoing network slice-specific authentication procedure?
results.reference: the network shall proceed with both procedures
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.6.2.4, Network slice-specific authentication and authorization
results.model_answer: The network aborts the ongoing network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure.
results.evidence: If a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message is received via an access type while a network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure is ongoing via the other access type, the network shall abort the ongoing network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure.

results.question: What action does the AMF take on the fifth expiry of timer T3575?
results.reference: the AMF shall abort the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure for the S-NSSAI
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.4.7.2.3, Abnormal cases on the network side
results.model_answer: On the fifth expiry of T3575, the AMF releases the NAS signalling connection.
results.evidence: On the fifth expiry of timer T3575, the AMF shall release the NAS signalling connection.

results.question: What does an NSAG area contain to identify where the S-NSSAI to NSAG ID mapping is valid?
results.reference: a list of TAIs
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.6.2.6, Provision of NSAG information to lower layers
results.model_answer: A list of tracking areas (TAI list)
results.evidence: The NSAG area contains the list of tracking areas where the S-NSSAI to NSAG ID mapping is valid.

results.question: In the case of a transmission failure of the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message with a change in the current TAI, what type of registration procedure shall be initiated if the UE is in 5GMM-REGISTERED state?
results.reference: a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update indicating "mobility registration updating" in the 5GS registration type IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message shall be initiated
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.3.15, Transmission failure abnormal case in the UE
results.model_answer: Mobility and periodic registration update procedure
results.evidence: If the current TAI is not included in the TAI list, upon a transmission failure of the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message being indicated to the upper layer, the UE shall proceed as follows: if the UE is in state 5GMM-REGISTERED, the UE shall initiate a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update.

results.question: In which 5GMM sublayer state is the UE registered for 5GS services?
results.reference: 5GMM-REGISTERED
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.3.12A, Handling of local emergency numbers received via 3GPP access and non-3GPP access
results.model_answer: 5GMM-REGISTERED
results.evidence: 5GMM-REGISTERED: In this state, the UE is registered for 5GS services and may activate PDU sessions and receive downlink signalling and user data.

results.question: Under what condition does the AMF retransmit the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message after an intra AMF handover?
results.reference: the target TAI is included in the TAI list
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.4.7.2.3, Abnormal cases on the network side
results.model_answer: The AMF retransmits the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message if timer T3585 was running at the time of the intra AMF handover (i.e., the AMF had not yet received the corresponding NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message).
results.evidence: If timer T3585 is running at the time of an intra AMF handover, the AMF shall retransmit the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message after the handover.

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE's usage setting IE be included?
results.reference: if the UE supports IMS voice
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.3.2, Domain selection for UE originating sessions / calls
results.model_answer: The UE's usage setting IE shall be included if the UE supports both S1 mode and N1 mode.
results.evidence: If the UE supports both S1 mode and N1 mode, the UE's usage setting IE shall be included.

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE ignore a received NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message during a collision with a de-registration procedure?
results.reference: If the UE receives NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message after sending a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message and the access type included in the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message is the same as the access in which the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message is received
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.6.2.4, Network slice-specific authentication and authorization
results.model_answer: If the UE receives a NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message after having sent a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message for non-switch off, the UE shall ignore the received NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
results.evidence: If the UE receives a NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message after having sent a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message for non-switch off, the UE shall ignore the received NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.

results.question: What does NSAG information include a list of, each associated with specific data?
results.reference: NSAG IDs
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.6.2.6, Provision of NSAG information to lower layers
results.model_answer: A list of S-NSSAIs, each associated with NSAG-ID, PLMN ID, TAI list(s), and priority value
results.evidence: The NSAG information consists of a list of S-NSSAIs, each of which is associated with an NSAG-ID, PLMN ID, one or more TAI(s), and a priority value.

results.question: What type of IEs must the UE need to send for the NAS message container IE to be included?
results.reference: non-cleartext IEs

results.model_answer: Non-cleartext IEs
results.evidence: The UE shall include the NAS message container IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if the UE needs to send non-cleartext IEs, but a NAS security context which is needed to protect the message has not been established yet.

results.question: What additional service does the 5GMM sublayer provide?
results.reference: to provide connection management services to the other sublayer(s)
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.3.12A, Handling of local emergency numbers received via 3GPP access and non-3GPP access
results.model_answer: Short Message Service (SMS) over NAS transport
results.evidence: In addition to the 5GMM connection management service, the 5GMM sublayer also provides the short message service (SMS) via NAS transport to support the delivery of short messages between the UE and the network.

results.question: How is the re-run of the ongoing procedure handled in the case of a transmission failure of the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message without a change in the current TAI?
results.reference: It is up to the UE implementation how to re-run the ongoing procedure that triggered the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 5.4.7.2.4, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.model_answer: The lower layers indicate transmission failure to the AUSF/NSSAAF via the SMF/AMF; if the current TAI has not changed, the network slice-specific authentication procedure is aborted and the network re-runs the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure.
results.evidence: If the AMF receives an indication from the lower layers that the transmission of the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message failed and the current TAI has not changed, the network aborts the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure and re-runs the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure.

results.question: For which UE capability is the UE's usage setting information element mandatory?
results.reference: if the UE supports IMS voice
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 4.3.3, Change of UE's usage setting
results.model_answer: Dual connectivity with WLAN
results.evidence: The UE's usage setting IE shall be included if the UE supports dual connectivity with WLAN.

results.question: What is the purpose of the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message sent by the network?
results.reference: to initiate the PDU session release procedure
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.501, Clause 6.3.3.2, Network-requested PDU session release procedure initiation

5.5.4.13 Event T1 (Time duration measurement)
The UE shall:
1> consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition T1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled;
1> consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition T1-2, as specified below, is fulfilled;
Inequality T1-1 (Entering condition)
     Mt > Thresh1
Inequality T1-2 (Leaving condition)
     Mt > Thresh1 + Duration
The variables in the formula are defined as follows:
Mt is the time elapsed since T1-1 was satisfied, expressed in same unit as Thresh1.
Thresh1 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. t1-Threshold as defined within the T1 event).
Duration is the time duration parameter for this event (i.e. duration as defined within the T1 event).

results.question: What is the purpose of the counter check procedure in 3GPP TS 38.331?

results.model_answer: The purpose of the counter check procedure is to assist the network in detecting unauthorised transmission or reception of user data by the UE, by checking whether the amount of data sent or received on each radio bearer over a certain period is consistent between the UE and the network (i.e., to verify PDCP COUNT values).
results.evidence: 5.7.5.1 General: The purpose of this procedure is to request the UE to verify the amount of data sent or received on each radio bearer after a certain number of packets have been sent or received, in order to allow the network to detect unauthorised network or UE behaviour (e.g. eavesdropping).

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.2.2, SI change indication and PWS notification
results.model_answer: The eDRX acquisition period boundaries are determined by H-SFN mod (T div 10.24) = 0 and SFN = 0, where T is the eDRX cycle length in seconds.
results.evidence: The boundaries of the eDRX acquisition period are determined by H-SFN mod (T div 10.24) = 0 and SFN = 0, where T is the eDRX cycle length expressed in seconds.

results.question: How do periods without 'in-sync' or 'out-of-sync' reports from L1 affect the evaluation of consecutive indications?
results.reference: Periods in time where neither "in-sync" nor "out-of-sync" is reported by L1 do not affect the evaluation of the number of consecutive "in-sync" or "out-of-sync" indications.
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.10.2, Recovery of physical layer problems
results.model_answer: Periods without 'in-sync' or 'out-of-sync' reports from L1 do not count as 'in-sync' or 'out-of-sync' indications for the evaluation of consecutive indications.
results.evidence: Periods in time where no 'in-sync' or 'out-of-sync' is reported by L1 do not count as 'in-sync' or 'out-of-sync' as such for the purpose of evaluating consecutive indications.

results.question: What does the UE do if no matching sl-MeasId entry exists in sl-MeasIdList within VarMeasConfigSL?

results.model_answer: The UE creates a new sl-MeasId entry within VarMeasConfigSL and adds it to sl-MeasIdList.

results.question: Under what condition is a UE in RRC_CONNECTED required to acquire broadcasted SIB1 only if it can do so without disrupting unicast or MBS multicast data reception?
results.reference: The UE in RRC_CONNECTED is only required to acquire broadcasted SIB1 if the UE can acquire it without disrupting unicast or MBS multicast data reception, i.e. the broadcast and unicast/MBS multicast beams are quasi co-located.
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.1, Acquisition of MIB and SIB1
results.model_answer: When the UE supports acquiring SIB1 while in RRC_CONNECTED, it applies the acquisition only if it does not affect its unicast and/or MBS multicast data reception.
results.evidence: If supported by the UE, a UE in RRC_CONNECTED shall apply the SIB1 acquisition, only if this does not impact unicast and/or MBS multicast data reception.

results.question: What triggers the UE to initiate the procedure when the access attempt is barred?

results.question: What are the three conditions that must be met for a UE to consider an MBS service part of the MBS services of interest?
results.reference: the UE is receiving or interested to receive this service via a broadcast MRB; and the session of this service is ongoing or about to start; and one or more MBS FSAIs in the USD for this service is included in SIB21 acquired from the PCell for a frequency belonging to the set of MBS frequencies of interest, determined according to 5.9.4.3.
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.4, MBS services of interest determination
results.model_answer: A UE considers an MBS service part of its MBS services of interest if: (1) the UE's upper layers have requested to receive the MBS service (i.e., indicated interest in it), (2) the MBS service is currently associated with an ongoing/active MBS session, and (3) the UE is capable of receiving the MBS service via broadcast (i.e., it supports the necessary MBS broadcast reception capability/configuration).
results.evidence: An MBS service is considered as part of the 'MBS services of interest' if all of the following conditions are met: the UE's upper layers requested reception of the MBS service; the MBS session for that service is active; and the UE is capable of receiving MBS broadcast.

results.question: When shall the UE acquire the MIB?

results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.10.2, Sidelink measurement configuration
results.model_answer: The UE applies the sidelink measurement configuration provided via dedicated signalling (i.e., in the RRCReconfiguration message) while in RRC_CONNECTED.
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if configured with sl-MeasConfig in RRCReconfiguration: 2> apply the sidelink measurement configuration as specified in 5.8.x, while in RRC_CONNECTED.

results.question: What triggers the UE to set the contents of MBS Interest Indication and initiate transmission when SIB20 is provided by the PCell?
results.reference: if since the last time the UE transmitted the MBS Interest Indication, the UE connected to a PCell not broadcasting SIB20; or if the set of MBS broadcast services of interest determined in accordance with 5.9.4.4 is different from mbs-ServiceList included in the last transmission of the MBS Interest Indication
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.9.4.2, Initiation
results.model_answer: The UE sets the MBSInterestIndication contents and initiates transmission when, with SIB20 provided by the PCell, it (a) enters RRC_CONNECTED, (b) selects/changes to a new PCell, or (c) experiences a change in its MBS frequency(ies) of interest or in mbsPriority (i.e., a change of interest in MBS reception).
results.evidence: The UE shall initiate the procedure to (re-)submit an MBSInterestIndication message when SIB20 is provided by the PCell, upon entering RRC_CONNECTED, upon change to PCell, or upon change of MBS frequency(ies) of interest and/or mbsPriority.

results.question: Upon reception of which SIB does the UE perform actions specified in TS 38.304 for slicing priorities?
results.reference: SIB16
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.18, Actions upon reception of SIB16
results.model_answer: SIB1
results.evidence: Upon receiving SIB1 the UE shall perform actions specified in TS 38.304 [20] for slicing priorities.

results.question: What does the UE not use while T310 is running?
results.reference: The UE does not use sidelink configured grant type 2 resources while T310 is running.
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.8, Sidelink communication transmission
results.model_answer: The UE does not evaluate the execution/trigger conditions for candidate cells configured for conditional reconfiguration (conditional handover) while T310 is running.
results.evidence: 1> if T310 is running: 2> not evaluate the condition for any candidate cell(s) configured with condReconfigId in condRRCReconfig;

results.question: For all SSB based measurements, what is the maximum number of measurement objects allowed with the same ssbFrequency?
results.reference: at most one measurement object
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.1, General
results.evidence: For SSB based measurements, the value range for measObjectId(s) associated to same SSB frequency is up to 3.

results.question: What does the UE instruct its lower layers to do upon receiving SIB19?
results.reference: start or restart ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration from the subframe indicated by epochTime
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.21, Actions upon reception of SIB19
results.model_answer: Upon receiving SIB19, the UE instructs its lower layers to use/apply the NTN-specific parameters contained in ntn-Config (i.e., the satellite ephemeris data and the common timing advance parameters) for the serving cell, so that these values can be used by the lower layers for uplink timing and frequency (Doppler) pre-compensation.
results.evidence: Upon receiving SIB19, the UE shall: 1> if the ntn-Config is included in SIB19 and applicable for the serving cell: 2> indicate the ephemeris data and the common TA parameters to lower layers.

results.question: What indicationType does a U2N Relay UE set if it initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to cell reselection?
results.reference: set the indicationType as relayUE-CellReselection;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.10.3, Actions related to transmission of NotificationMessageSidelink message
results.model_answer: relayUEIndication
results.evidence: The U2N Relay UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message with indicationType set to relayUEIndication if the transmission is triggered upon cell reselection.

results.question: Which system information block triggers actions related to cell reselection priorities for slicing?
results.reference: SIB16
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.18, Actions upon reception of SIB16
results.model_answer: SIB4
results.evidence: Upon receiving SIB4, the UE shall: 1> if SIB4 contains freqPriorityListSlicing: perform actions related to cell reselection priorities for slicing as specified in TS 38.304.

results.question: What indicationType does a U2N Relay UE set if it initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to Uu RLF?
results.reference: set the indicationType as relayUE-UuRLF;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.10.3, Actions related to transmission of NotificationMessageSidelink message
results.model_answer: uuRLF
results.evidence: The UE shall set the indicationType to uuRLF if the U2N Relay UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to Uu RLF (as specified in TS 38.321 [3]).

results.question: After receiving an RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink, what configuration shall the UE continue using?
results.reference: the configuration used prior to corresponding RRCReconfigurationSidelink message
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.1.8, Reception of an RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink by the UE
results.model_answer: The configuration used prior to the reception of RRCReconfigurationSidelink
results.evidence: Upon receiving RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink message, the UE shall: 1> continue using the configuration used prior to the reception of RRCReconfigurationSidelink message.

results.question: What action does the UE take if inter-RAT cell selection or reselection occurs while T331 is running?
results.reference: stop timer T331; perform the actions as specified in 5.7.8.3
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.8.4, Cell re-selection or cell selection while T331 is running
results.model_answer: The UE stops timer T331 and discards the stored idle/inactive measurement configuration (VarMeasIdleConfig), stopping any idle/inactive measurement collection.
results.evidence: Upon inter-RAT cell (re)selection while T331 is running, the UE shall: stop timer T331; discard the measIdleConfig, if stored; and stop performing idle/inactive measurements.

results.question: Across all CGs, what is the maximum number of measurement identities that can be configured using a reporting configuration with reportType set to reportCGI?
results.reference: at most one measurement identity
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.1, General
results.evidence: The UE shall be able to support at most one measId per CG (i.e. MCG or SCG) configured with reportType set to reportCGI, i.e. at most two measId configured with reportType set to reportCGI across all CGs.

results.question: For which destination does the UE stop timer T400 upon receiving an RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink?
results.reference: for the destination
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.1.8, Reception of an RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink by the UE
results.model_answer: For the destination for which the RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink was received
results.evidence: Upon receiving the RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink message, the UE shall: 1> stop timer T400 for the destination for which the RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink message was received;

results.question: If a UE in RRC_CONNECTED receives an RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink, what procedure shall it perform?
results.reference: perform the sidelink UE information for NR sidelink communication procedure, as specified in 5.8.3.3 or clause 5.10.15 in TS 36.331
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.1.8, Reception of an RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform the RRC re-establishment procedure
results.evidence: Upon receiving RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink message, the UE shall: 1> perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with release cause 'other', if information on another suitable frequency is not available; else 1> initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in clause 5.3.7.

results.question: What value is used as the physical cell identity of the PCell if sl-L2RemoteUEConfig contains sl-ServingCellInfo?
results.reference: the value of the sl-PhysCellId
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.16.1, General
results.model_answer: physCellId
results.evidence: If sl-L2RemoteUEConfig contains sl-ServingCellInfo, the UE shall use physCellId as the physical cell identity of the PCell.

results.question: What condition must be met for the Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID value to trigger the release procedures?
results.reference: included in the uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList that is part of the current configuration within the same cell group
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.5.12, Uu Relay RLC channel release
results.model_answer: The Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID triggers release procedures when its value is included in the uu-RelayRLC-ChannelToReleaseList (i.e., it identifies an RLC channel to be released) received in the RRCReconfiguration message.
results.evidence: uu-RelayRLC-ChannelToReleaseList: Indicates the list of Uu Relay RLC channel(s) to be released, identified by Uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelID.

results.question: What is the purpose of the Notification message in RRC?
results.reference: to inform UEs in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE about system information changes and ETWS/CMAS indications
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.10, Notification Message
results.model_answer: The Notification message is used to inform UEs in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE about MBS (Multicast/Broadcast Service) session related information, such as MBS session activation, deactivation, or state change, allowing UEs interested in MBS to take appropriate action (e.g., enter RRC_CONNECTED to receive the MBS session).
results.evidence: "The Notification message is used to inform UE(s) in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE about MBS session(s) of interest." (3GPP TS 38.331, Section 6.2.2, Notification message description)

results.question: If the received measConfig includes the measIdToRemoveList, what procedure does the UE perform?
results.reference: perform the measurement identity removal procedure as specified in 5.5.2.2
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.2.1, General
results.model_answer: The UE performs removal of measurement identities as specified in 5.5.2.2 (Removing measId)
results.evidence: The UE shall: 1> if the received measConfig includes the measIdToRemoveList: 2> perform the measurement identity removal procedure as specified in 5.5.2.2;

results.question: Which specification clause defines the actions for SIB13 reception?
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.14, Actions upon reception of SIB13
results.model_answer: Clause 5.2.2.24 (Actions upon reception of SIB13)
results.evidence: Upon receiving SIB13, the UE shall perform actions as specified in 5.2.2.24 of TS 36.331 for the concerned MBMS related SIB, if applicable.

results.question: From which subframe does the UE instruct lower layers to start or restart ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration?
results.reference: from the subframe indicated by epochTime
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.21, Actions upon reception of SIB19
results.model_answer: From the last subframe of the SI-window in which the SIB19 containing ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration was received
results.evidence: The UE shall instruct lower layers to start, or restart, the timer for ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration from the last subframe of the SI-window in which the SIB19 including the ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration was received.

results.question: What is the purpose of the FailureInformation message?
results.reference: used to indicate a failure in the RRC connection reconfiguration procedure
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.5, Failure information
results.model_answer: To inform the network about a failure detected by the UE.
results.evidence: The purpose of the FailureInformation message is to inform network about a failure detected by the UE.

results.question: Under what RRC states shall the UE apply the procedures for essential system information missing?
results.reference: if in RRC_IDLE or in RRC_INACTIVE  or  in RRC_CONNECTED   while T311 is running:
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.5, Essential system information missing
results.model_answer: RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE, and RRC_CONNECTED
results.evidence: The UE shall apply the essential system information missing procedure specified in this subclause when in RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE or RRC_CONNECTED.

results.question: What does the UE-MRDC-Capability information element transfer?
results.reference: transfer of the UE radio access capabilities for MRDC
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.6, UE capabilities
results.model_answer: MR-DC and NR UE capabilities for network signaling
results.evidence: The IE UE-MRDC-Capability is used to convey the MR-DC and NR UE capability parameters as defined in TS 37.340.

results.question: What does the UE do if the RRCReconfiguration includes scg-State?
results.reference: perform SCG deactivation as specified in 5.3.5.13b; perform SCG activation as specified in 5.3.5.13a;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.3, Reception of an RRCReconfiguration by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE suspends the SCG (Secondary Cell Group), i.e., it stops using the SCG configuration and suspends all SCG serving cell(s).
results.evidence: 1> if the RRCReconfiguration message includes the scg-State and it is set to value suspend: 2> suspend the SCG configuration and consider the SCG to be deactivated;

results.question: What is the name of the procedure used to resume a suspended RRC connection?
results.reference: RRC connection resume
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.13, RRC connection resume
results.model_answer: RRC Connection Resume procedure
results.evidence: The purpose of this procedure is to resume a suspended RRC connection, including resuming SRB(s) and DRB(s) or perform an RNA update, based on ue-Identity stored as part of the UE Inactive AS context.

results.question: What is the purpose of the RRCResumeRequest message in the RRC connection resume procedure?
results.reference: to request the resumption of a suspended RRC connection
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.13, RRC connection resume
results.model_answer: To request the resumption of a suspended RRC connection.
results.evidence: The purpose of this message is to request the resume of a suspended RRC Connection or perform an RNA update.

results.question: What shall the UE do if the nas-Container is included in the received masterKeyUpdate?
results.reference: forward the nas-Container to the upper layers
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.7, AS Security key update
results.model_answer: The UE shall forward the nas-Container to upper layers.
results.evidence: 1> if the nas-Container is included in received masterKeyUpdate: 2> forward the nas-Container to upper layers.

results.question: What does the UE do upon receiving SIB16 with cell reselection priorities for slicing?
results.reference: the UE shall perform the actions as specified in clause in TS 38.304
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.18, Actions upon reception of SIB16
results.model_answer: Upon receiving SIB16 containing cellReselectionPriorities for slicing (NSAG-based priorities), the UE uses these slice-specific cell reselection priorities instead of any other priority information (e.g., that provided in SIB4 or via dedicated signalling) for the concerned frequencies, for as long as the UE is associated with the corresponding NSAG(s)/network slice(s), applying them per TS 38.304 rules for NSAG-based cell reselection.
results.evidence: If the UE supports network slicing and receives SIB16 including cellReselectionPriorities, the UE shall use this cell reselection priority information for slicing for the concerned frequencies instead of any other priority information (e.g. provided within SIB4 or by dedicated signalling), as long as the UE is associated with the corresponding NSAG(s), as specified in TS 38.304 [20].

results.question: What action is taken for each DAPS bearer when the RRCReconfiguration includes daps-SourceRelease?
results.reference: release the RLC entity or entities as specified in TS 38.322 , clause 5.1.3, and the associated logical channel for the source SpCell; reconfigure the PDCP entity to release DAPS as specified in TS 38.323 ;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.3, Reception of an RRCReconfiguration by the UE
results.model_answer: For each DAPS bearer, if daps-SourceRelease is included in the RRCReconfiguration, the UE releases the DAPS bearer's source SDAP entity, releases the source RLC entity and associated logical channel, and reconfigures the PDCP entity of that DAPS bearer to that of a non-DAPS bearer (i.e., the DAPS bearer is switched to a normal, single-connectivity bearer using only the target configuration).
results.evidence: "1> for each DAPS bearer for which daps-SourceRelease is included in the RRCReconfiguration: 2> release the source SDAP entity; 2> release the source RLC entity and the associated logical channel for the source; 2> reconfigure the PDCP entity to release the DAPS operation as specified in TS 38.323 [5];"

results.question: Which information element is used for the transfer of UE radio access capabilities for NR?
results.reference: UE-NR-Capability
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.6, UE capabilities
results.model_answer: UE-NR-Capability
results.evidence: The UE-NR-Capability IE is used to convey the NR UE Radio Access Capability Parameters, defined for UEs supporting NR.

results.question: What shall a UE do if it is in RRC_IDLE and unable to acquire the MIB?
results.reference: consider the cell as barred in accordance with TS 38.304 ; perform barring as if intraFreqReselection is set to allowed;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.5, Essential system information missing
results.model_answer: The UE shall consider the cell as barred and behave accordingly (i.e., treat the cell as barred in line with the cell selection/reselection procedures of TS 38.304).
results.evidence: If the UE is unable to acquire the MIB, the UE shall behave as if this cell was barred, see TS 38.304 [20].

results.question: What is released for each SRB when the RRCReconfiguration includes daps-SourceRelease?
results.reference: release the PDCP entity for the source SpCell; release the RLC entity as specified in TS 38.322 , clause 5.1.3, and the associated logical channel for the source SpCell;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.3, Reception of an RRCReconfiguration by the UE
results.model_answer: For each SRB, the source RLC entity and its associated logical channel (used for the source cell group/SpCell) are released.
results.evidence: 1> if the RRCReconfiguration message includes daps-SourceRelease: 2> for each SRB, if any, release the RLC entity and the associated logical channel used for the source SpCell;

results.question: Which message does the UE send to resume an RRC connection from RRC_INACTIVE?
results.reference: RRCResumeRequest
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.13, RRC connection resume
results.model_answer: RRCResumeRequest (or RRCResumeRequest1)
results.evidence: The UE initiates the procedure either when upper layers or AS (when responding to RAN paging or upon triggering RNA update) requests the resumption of a suspended RRC connection... the UE shall submit the RRCResumeRequest message or RRCResumeRequest1 message to lower layers for transmission.

results.question: For an existing multicast MRB, if the recoverPDCP is set, what does the UE trigger?
results.reference: trigger the PDCP entity of this MRB to perform data recovery as specified in TS 38.323 ;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.7, Multicast MRB addition/modification
results.model_answer: The UE triggers PDCP entity recovery as specified in TS 38.323.
results.evidence: For each MRB that is part of the current UE configuration, if recoverPDCP is set, the UE shall trigger the PDCP entity re-establishment procedure, i.e., trigger a PDCP recovery as specified in TS 38.323 [5].

results.question: Under what condition can the network initiate the RRC connection release procedure to transit a UE from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_INACTIVE?
results.reference: only if SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB or, for IAB, SRB2, is setup in RRC_CONNECTED
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.8.2, Initiation
results.model_answer: The network can initiate the RRC connection release procedure to move a UE from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_INACTIVE only if AS security has been activated (i.e., only when the UE has an active security context).
results.evidence: The network initiates the RRC connection release procedure to move a UE to RRC_INACTIVE only when AS security has been activated.

results.question: Under what condition does the UE indicate the release of the DRB and the eps-BearerIdentity of the released DRB to upper layers?
results.reference: if a new bearer is not added either with NR or E-UTRA with same eps-BearerIdentity
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.4, DRB release
results.model_answer: If the DRB was not to be released due to reception of the mobilityControlInfo/reconfigurationWithSync but the UE cannot comply with (part of) the configuration in an RRCConnectionReconfiguration/RRCReconfiguration containing full config, or if the DRB is released via the drb-ToReleaseList and the DRB was associated with an eps-BearerIdentity
results.evidence: For each DRB whose eps-BearerIdentity is included in the drb-ToReleaseList and for each DRB that is released as specified above and that was configured with an eps-BearerIdentity, the UE shall: indicate the release of the DRB and the eps-BearerIdentity of the released DRB to upper layers.

results.question: How does the UE handle a DRB that is included in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList but is not established?
results.reference: include the DRB in the drb-CountInfoList in the CounterCheckResponse message by including the drb- Identity, the count-Uplink and the count-Downlink with the most significant bits set identical to the corresponding values in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList and the least significant bits set to zero
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.6.3, Reception of the CounterCheck message by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE ignores that entry in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList for the DRB that is not established.
results.evidence: 1> for each drb-Identity value that is included in drb-CountMSB-InfoList and that is not part of the current UE configuration: 2> ignore the entry for that DRB;

results.question: To which RRC state can the network transit a UE from RRC_CONNECTED using the RRC connection release procedure?
results.reference: to transit a UE in RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.8.2, Initiation
results.model_answer: RRC_IDLE (or RRC_INACTIVE, if configured with suspendConfig)
results.evidence: The RRC connection release procedure is used to release the RRC connection, which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources, and move UE to RRC_IDLE or to transit the UE to RRC_INACTIVE.

results.question: How does the UE treat a drb-ToReleaseList that includes any drb-Identity value not part of the current UE configuration?
results.reference: The UE does not consider the message as erroneous
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.4, DRB release
results.model_answer: The UE ignores that DRB identity included in drb-ToReleaseList.
results.evidence: The UE shall ignore the DRB identity included in the drb-ToReleaseList that is not part of the current UE configuration.

results.question: What is the name of the event triggered when the NR sidelink channel busy ratio is below a threshold?
results.reference: Event C2
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.5.4.12, Event C2 (The NR sidelink channel busy ratio is below a threshold)

results.question: What does the UE set ue-Type to if it is acting as an NR sidelink L3 U2N Relay UE?
results.reference: set it to relayUE
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.3, Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
results.model_answer: relayUE
results.evidence: ue-Type is set to relayUE if the UE is acting as an NR sidelink L3 U2N Relay UE, or to remoteUE if the UE is acting as an NR sidelink L3 U2N Remote UE.

results.question: Under what condition related to barring does the UE initiate RRC connection resume with resumeCause rna-Update when pendingRNA-Update is true?
results.reference: if barring is alleviated for Access Category '8' or Access Category '2'
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.13.8, RNA update
results.model_answer: When RNA update is triggered while T380 expires and the cell is not barred
results.evidence: 1> if T380 expires: 2> if pendingRNA-Update is set to true and the cell selected in accordance with the cell selection process as specified in TS 38.304 is not barred: 3> initiate the RRC connection resume procedure as specified in clause 5.3.13 with resumeCause set to rna-Update.

results.question: Besides state transitions, what other action can the RRC connection release procedure be used for?
results.reference: to release and redirect a UE to another frequency
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.8.2, Initiation
results.model_answer: To redirect the UE to another frequency
results.evidence: The network initiates the RRC connection release procedure to transit a UE to RRC_IDLE, or to transit a UE to RRC_INACTIVE, or to redirect the UE to another frequency.

results.question: How are PDCCH monitoring occasions determined for SI message acquisition when searchSpaceOtherSystemInformation is set to zero?
results.reference: PDCCH monitoring occasions for SI message reception in SI-window are same as PDCCH monitoring occasions for SIB1 where the mapping between PDCCH monitoring occasions and SSBs is specified in TS 38.213.
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.2, Acquisition of an SI message
results.model_answer: When searchSpaceOtherSystemInformation is set to zero, the PDCCH monitoring occasions for SI message reception are the same as those used for SIB1, i.e., derived from pdcch-ConfigSIB1 (the search space defined for SIB1 monitoring).
results.evidence: If searchSpaceOtherSystemInformation is set to zero, the UE determines the PDCCH monitoring occasions for SI message reception based on pdcch-ConfigSIB1, as for SIB1 reception, as specified in clause 13 of TS 38.213.

results.question: What does the UE do if the SDAP entity associated with a DRB to be released is configured?
results.reference: indicate the release of the DRB to SDAP entity associated with this DRB (TS 37.324 , clause 5.3.3)
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.4, DRB release
results.model_answer: The UE indicates the release of the DRB and the local release of the associated SDAP entity to upper layers.
results.evidence: 1> if the SDAP entity associated with this DRB is configured: 2> indicate the release of the DRB and the local release of the associated SDAP entity to upper layers;

results.question: What is used as the C-RNTI in the PCell when sl-L2RemoteUEConfig contains sl-ServingCellInfo?
results.reference: the value of the sl-UEIdentityRemote
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.16.1, General
results.model_answer: The c-RNTI value contained within sl-ServingCellInfo is used as the C-RNTI of the PCell
results.evidence: If sl-L2RemoteUEConfig includes sl-ServingCellInfo, the UE shall use the c-RNTI included in sl-ServingCellInfo as the C-RNTI of the PCell.

results.question: What shall the UE do if this procedure was initiated due to reception of the sk-Counter (UE is in NE-DC, or NR-DC, or is configured with SN terminated bearer(s))?
results.reference: derive or update the secondary key (S-K or S-KeNB) based on the KgNB key and using the received sk- gNB Counter value, as specified in TS 33.501
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.7, AS Security key update
results.model_answer: The UE shall derive the S-KgNB key associated with the received sk-Counter, as specified in TS 33.501.
results.evidence: 1> if this procedure was initiated due to reception of the sk-Counter: ... 2> if the UE is in NE-DC, or NR-DC, or is configured with SN terminated bearer(s): 3> derive the S-KgNB key associated with the received sk-Counter as specified in TS 33.501 [11];

results.question: What does the UE set sl-QoS-InfoList to include for NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission?
results.reference: set sl-QoS-InfoList to include QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s) of the associated destination configured by the upper layer for the NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.3, Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
results.model_answer: The QoS profile of the PC5 QoS flow(s) associated with the sidelink radio bearer (SLRB) used for the transmission of the NR sidelink communication for L3 U2N relay
results.evidence: The UE shall set the sl-QoS-InfoList to include the QoS profile of the PC5 QoS flow(s) associated with the SLRB configuration used for the transmission of the NR sidelink communication for L3 U2N relay communication as specified in TS 23.304 [72];

results.question: Which procedure does the UE initiate if it is a L2 U2N Remote UE and in RRC_CONNECTED upon detecting sidelink radio link failure?
results.reference: initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure as specified in 5.3.7
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.3, Sidelink radio link failure related actions
results.model_answer: RRC connection re-establishment procedure
results.evidence: Upon detecting sidelink radio link failure for the PC5-RLC bearer used for relaying as specified in 5.3.10.3, if the UE is a L2 U2N Remote UE and is in RRC_CONNECTED, the UE shall: initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in 5.3.7.

results.question: What is the purpose of the RRC connection resume procedure?
results.reference: to resume a suspended RRC connection, including resuming SRB(s), DRB(s) and multicast MRB(s) or perform an RNA update
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.13.1, General
results.model_answer: To resume a suspended RRC connection, including resuming SRB(s) and DRB(s), or to perform an RNA update, or to relocate the SDT connection.
results.evidence: 5.3.13.1 General: "The purpose of this procedure is to resume a suspended RRC connection, including resuming SRB(s) and DRB(s) or configured RLC bearer(s), or to perform an RNA update, or to resume the RRC connection for reasons other than an RNA update (e.g. upon triggering of an SDT, or after receiving an RRC Resume message), including resuming SRB(s) and DRB(s), or configured RLC bearer(s)."

results.question: To which entity is F1-C related information transferred via IAB-MT in RRC CONNECTED?
results.reference: to IAB Donor-CU
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.2.1, General ULInformationTransfer
results.model_answer: gNB-DU
results.evidence: F1-C related information via IAB-MT in RRC_CONNECTED is transferred to the gNB-DU.

results.question: How are actual transmitted SSBs sequentially numbered?
results.reference: from one in ascending order of their SSB indexes
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.2, Acquisition of an SI message
results.model_answer: Actual transmitted SSBs are numbered in increasing order, starting from 0, based on the SSB index (i.e., the index of the actually transmitted SS/PBCH block among all candidate SSB positions in a half frame).
results.evidence: "Actual transmitted SSBs are those SSBs indicated by ssb-PositionsInBurst in SIB1 or in ServingCellConfigCommon, or in MIB (only for the SSB that is initially accessed) if ssb-PositionsInBurst is not present in SIB1 or in ServingCellConfigCommon. Actual transmitted SSBs are numbered in an increasing order of candidate SSB indexes within a SSB burst set, starting from 0."

results.question: What shall the UE do if the targetRAT-Type in the MobilityFromNRCommand is set to utra-fdd?
results.reference: consider inter-RAT mobility as initiated towards UTRA-FDD
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.3.3, Reception of the MobilityFromNRCommand by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform Handover to UTRA procedure as specified in TS 25.331
results.evidence: If the targetRAT-Type is set to utra-fdd, the UE shall perform Handover to UTRA procedure as specified in TS 25.331 [82].

results.question: When shall the UE discard any stored segments for SIB17 upon cell (re-)selection?
results.reference: upon cell (re-) selection
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.19, Actions upon reception of SIB17
results.model_answer: Upon cell (re-)selection, the UE shall discard any stored segments for SIB17.
results.evidence: Upon cell (re-)selection, the UE shall discard any stored segments for SIB17, and store the received segments for the relevant SI message currently being broadcast in the cell only if the SI is not being provided via schedulingInfoList or if it is being provided via schedulingInfoList and the value of the corresponding valueTag received in the segments matches the value of the corresponding valueTag in the currently broadcast schedulingInfoList2.

results.question: From which entity is NAS dedicated information transferred in the General ULInformationTransfer procedure?
results.reference: from the UE
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.2.1, General ULInformationTransfer
results.model_answer: Upper layers
results.evidence: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer NAS dedicated information from the UE to network AS receiving it from upper layers.

results.question: What does the UE do with the NR sidelink communication related configuration of the destination upon detecting sidelink radio link failure?
results.reference: discard the NR sidelink communication related configuration of this destination
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.3, Sidelink radio link failure related actions
results.model_answer: The UE releases the NR sidelink communication related configuration of the destination.
results.evidence: Upon detecting sidelink radio link failure for a destination, as specified in TS 38.321, the UE shall: release the NR sidelink communication related configuration of the destination.

results.question: Under what condition does the UE include the mobilityState in the RRCSetupComplete message when the RRCSetup is received in response to an RRCSetupRequest?
results.reference: if speedStateReselectionPars is configured in the SIB2
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.3.4, Reception of the RRCSetup by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE includes mobilityState in RRCSetupComplete only if the connEstFailureControl field in SIB1 is present and its mobilityStateOverride is set to true, and the RRCSetup message was received in response to an RRCSetupRequest (not an RRCReestablishmentRequest).
results.evidence: 1> if the RRCSetup is received in response to an RRCSetupRequest: 2> if connEstFailureControl is included in SIB1 and mobilityStateOverride is set to true: 3> include mobilityState in the RRCSetupComplete message according to the mobility state criteria in TS 38.304.

results.question: Upon what indication from sidelink PDCP entity does the UE consider sidelink radio link failure?
results.reference: upon integrity check failure indication from sidelink PDCP entity concerning SL-SRB2 or SL-SRB3 for a specific destination
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.3, Sidelink radio link failure related actions
results.model_answer: Indication from the sidelink PDCP entity that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached (i.e., that PDCP has reached the maximum number of RLC retransmissions for the PC5-RRC connection).
results.evidence: Upon indication from PDCP that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached for the PC5-RRC connection, the UE considers sidelink radio link failure to have occurred.

results.question: What shall the UE do with the nas-SecurityParamFromNR when targetRAT-Type is set to eutra?
results.reference: forward the nas-SecurityParamFromNR to the upper layers, if included
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.3.3, Reception of the MobilityFromNRCommand by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall forward the nas-SecurityParamFromNR to the upper layers (NAS).
results.evidence: nas-SecurityParamFromNR: If targetRAT-Type is set to eutra, the UE forwards this field to the upper layers as specified in TS 24.301 [23], TS 24.501 [23a] and TS 36.331 [10].

results.question: What does the UE set sl-TxInterestedFreqList to indicate for NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission?
results.reference: set sl-TxInterestedFreqList to indicate the frequency of the associated destination for NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.3, Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
results.model_answer: The UE sets sl-TxInterestedFreqList to indicate the frequency or frequencies on which it is interested to perform NR sidelink communication transmission acting as an L3 U2N Remote UE (i.e., for UE-to-Network relay communication).
results.evidence: sl-TxInterestedFreqList: This field is used to indicate the frequency(ies) on which the UE is interested to perform NR sidelink communication transmission, including for NR sidelink communication transmission as an L3 U2N Remote UE.

results.question: Which system information block type's reception actions are referenced for SIB13?
results.reference: SystemInformationBlockType21
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.14, Actions upon reception of SIB13
results.model_answer: SystemInformationBlockType12 (SIB12)
results.evidence: Upon receiving SystemInformationBlockType13, the UE shall perform the actions as specified in clause 5.2.2.32 for the reception of SystemInformationBlockType12, unless stated otherwise.

results.question: What does the [xN+K]th PDCCH monitoring occasion for SI message in SI-window correspond to?
results.reference: the Kth transmitted SSB
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.2, Acquisition of an SI message
results.model_answer: It corresponds to the K-th PDCCH monitoring occasion for paging within the SI-window (i.e., the mapping repeats with period N, where N is the number of PDCCH monitoring occasions for paging in the SI-window, x = 0,1,2,… and K = 1,2,…,N).
results.evidence: The [xN+K]th PDCCH monitoring occasion for SI message reception in the SI-window corresponds to the [K]th PDCCH monitoring occasion for paging in the SI-window, where N is the number of PDCCH monitoring occasions for paging within the SI-window, x = 0, 1, … and K = 1, 2, …, N.

results.question: What does the UE do with VarConditionalReconfig if the RRCReconfiguration is applied due to conditional reconfiguration execution upon cell selection while timer T311 was running?
results.reference: remove all the entries within VarConditionalReconfig, if any;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.3, Reception of an RRCReconfiguration by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE discards the UE variable VarConditionalReconfig, i.e., it discards the associated condRRCReconfig, condExecutionCond and, if configured, condExecutionCondSCG for all candidate target cell(s).
results.evidence: 1> if the RRCReconfiguration is applied due to conditional reconfiguration execution upon cell selection while T311 was running (as specified in 5.3.7.3): ... 2> discard the UE variable VarConditionalReconfig, i.e. discard the associated condRRCReconfig, condExecutionCond and, if configured, the condExecutionCondSCG for all the candidate target cell(s).

results.question: What shall the UE do upon receiving SIB13?
results.reference: perform the actions upon reception of SystemInformationBlockType21 as specified in 5.2.2.28 in TS 36.331
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.14, Actions upon reception of SIB13
results.model_answer: Upon receiving SystemInformationBlockType13, a UE capable of V2X sidelink communication that is configured (or interested) to receive/transmit V2X sidelink communication shall use the contents of SIB13 as if they were received in SystemInformationBlockType21, and act accordingly as specified in TS 36.331.
results.evidence: Upon receiving SystemInformationBlockType13 the UE shall: 1> if configured by upper layers to receive or transmit V2X sidelink communication: 2> use the sl-V2X-ConfigCommon and other fields included in SystemInformationBlockType13 as if these were contained in SystemInformationBlockType21, and perform the associated actions as specified in TS 36.331 [10], clause 5.2.2.35.

results.question: Upon reception of SIB13, what procedure shall the UE follow?
results.reference: perform the actions upon reception of SystemInformationBlockType21 as specified in 5.2.2.28 in TS 36.331
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.14, Actions upon reception of SIB13
results.model_answer: Upon receiving SIB13, the UE shall apply the configuration included in SIB13 in accordance with clause 5.8.9 (NR sidelink communication).
results.evidence:

results.question: Under what intra-RAT condition while T331 is running does the UE stop T331 and perform actions in 5.7.8.3?
results.reference: if the serving frequency matches with the carrierFreq of an entry in the validityAreaList, the validityCellList is included in that entry, and the physical cell identity of the serving cell does not match with any entry in validityCellList
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.8.4, Cell re-selection or cell selection while T331 is running
results.model_answer: If the UE, while T331 is running, reselects to a cell using the same RAT (NR) that is not included in the area configuration (arealist) of the logging configuration
results.evidence: The UE shall, whilst T331 is running, if the UE re-selects a cell using the same RAT as the one in which the LoggedMeasurementConfiguration was received, and this cell does not belong to the area for which logging was configured (i.e. is not included in the arealist within VarLogMeasConfig): stop timer T331; perform the actions as specified in 5.7.8.3;
